meta.radii_reported: grid brackets [last-below, first-above]; first_above_median=None is CENSORED (> grid max)
meta.note: r_gate (first flip) and r_vis(tau) (actual-output-drift threshold) are DISTINCT INDEPENDENT measured brackets, no assumed ordering; frozen/true drift magnitudes reported so 'no gate crossing' is not read as 'no output change'; frozen-flatness is sample-specific (fitted), NOT claimed to transfer to held-out rows.
meta.median_is_censored_inclusive: first_above_median is over ALL n directions with censored (never-crossing) directions counted as > grid-max; it is None when the MEDIAN direction never crosses. censored_frac and n_crossing/n_total are reported.
meta.crossing_fractions: crossing_fraction_by_radius / n_crossing_by_radius give the FRACTION of probes with any gate flip at each radius (the median flip count can be 0 while a nonzero fraction crosses).
meta.single_layer_source: retrain-N1000 single-layer bases are the FULL standalone atomic kernels (from naive_atomic_sum); every other cell's single-layer bases are the per-block components of the bottom_up branch (NOT the standalone atomic kernel), labelled per entry.
